profile.summary: A nonprofit that serves as the official support organization for California's community college system. It runs more than 50 programs in areas such as student success, workforce development, equity, community impact and climate action. It also houses the California College Guidance Initiative, which runs the CaliforniaColleges.edu college and career planning platform.

review.notes: The agenda names the Foundation for California Community Colleges (Sacramento) acting on behalf of CCGI. ProPublica, foundationccc.org and the CCGI partner-districts page (which lists Oakland Unified) confirm the legal name, EIN 68-0412350, phone, address and the 50+ programs. A search of foundationccc.org's CCGI page confirms CCGI is housed within the Foundation. The summary is neutral and supported.
